exposure: South East/East Asian vs. Australian/New Zealand born women
South Asian vs. Australian/New Zealand born women
cohort: 31,932 singleton term births at an Australian tertiary hospital between 2009 and 2013
finding: Compared to Australian/New Zealand born women, South Asian and South East/East Asian women had higher rates of both operative vaginal birth and emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: South Asian and South East/East Asian women experience higher rates of both operative vaginal birth and cesarean section in comparison to Australian/New Zealand women, independent of other risk factors for intrapartum interventions.
